# How to find a church location

Follow these steps one by one. Every step tells you what to do on a **laptop** and on an **Android phone**.

## Before you start

- You can use iMetrics and the Church Location Finder on a laptop or on an Android phone.
- Have the Paul’s Reporting Form ready (the PDF or a clear photo).
- Your screen may look a little different from the pictures, but the steps are the same.

---

## Part 1: In iMetrics

### Step 1. Open Training Center Groups

Open iMetrics and sign in. Then find **Training Center Groups** in the menu.

- **Laptop:** Click **Training Center Groups** in the menu on the left.
- **Android:** Tap the **☰** button (top left). The menu opens. Tap **Training Center Groups**.

### Step 2. Check that you are in your own group

Look at the top of the page. You will see a line like *East Africa › Kenya › your group name*. Make sure it is **your** group.

- **Laptop:** Your group name is shown at the top of the page.
- **Android:** Your group name is shown at the top of the screen.

> 💡 Not your group? Go back to the menu and choose your own Training Center Group.

### Step 3. Open your Paul’s Training Center

Scroll down to the list called **Training Centers**. Each Training Center has the name of its leader. We call this leader the **Paul**. Find your Paul’s name and click it.

- **Laptop:** Click your Paul’s name in the **PAUL** column.
- **Android:** Tap your Paul’s name.

### Step 4. Open the Churches tab

On the Paul’s page, scroll down. You will see three tabs. Click **Churches**.

- **Laptop:** Click the **Churches** tab.
- **Android:** Tap the **Churches** tab. Swipe sideways if you cannot see it.

### Step 5. Choose the church planter

Find the church planter you want to update. Click the planter’s name, or the pencil button at the end of the same row.

- **Laptop:** Click the planter’s name or the **✎** pencil.
- **Android:** Tap the planter’s name or the **✎** pencil.

> 💡 Use the planter’s name that has a number next to it on the Paul’s Reporting Form.

---

## Part 2: On the Paul’s Reporting Form

### Step 6. Find the church location on the form

Open the Paul’s Reporting Form. Find the planter’s name. Look across the same row to the **Village Name** column. That is the church location. Check how it is spelled. Also read the **Sub-county** and the **Ward** next to it. You will need them in Step 9.

- **Laptop:** Open the PDF on your laptop. Zoom in if the writing is small.
- **Android:** Open the PDF or photo. Pinch with two fingers to zoom in.

> 💡 Example: Alice Sidi Charo → Village Name “Timboni”, Ward “Dabaso”.

---

## Part 3: In the Church Location Finder

### Step 7. Open the finder and choose the country

Open the Church Location Finder. At the top, choose the **country** where the church is: Kenya or Tanzania.

- **Laptop:** Click **Kenya** or **Tanzania**.
- **Android:** Tap **Kenya** or **Tanzania**.

### Step 8. Type the village name

Type the Village Name from the form into the search box. You do not need the full name. The list updates as you type.

- **Laptop:** Click the search box and type the name.
- **Android:** Tap the search box and type the name.

> 💡 Type the name only. Do not type words like “village”, “ward” or “county”.

### Step 9. Pick the right place

Each result shows the name, the **Ward**, the **Sub County** and the County. Compare with the form. Choose the result where the **Ward matches** the form.

- Use **Matching name** to see exact matches only.
- Use **Similar spellings** if you cannot find the name.
- Use **All** to see everything.

<!-- -->

- **Laptop:** Read the Ward in each result. Use the buttons above the list to filter.
- **Android:** Scroll the list. Check the Ward in each result.

> 💡 In this example the exact name “Timboni” is in Adu ward, but the form says Dabaso. So choose a Timboni in **Dabaso**. If Dabaso has more than one, ask your Paul which one is right.

### Step 10. Copy the coordinates

Press **Copy** next to the right place. It copies the latitude and longitude together, for example `-3.3439, 40.0073`. Now go back to iMetrics and paste it where the location is needed.

- **Laptop:** Click **Copy**. It changes to “Copied ✓”. To paste, press **Ctrl + V**.
- **Android:** Tap **Copy**. It changes to “Copied ✓”. To paste, press and hold in the box, then tap **Paste**.

---

## If something goes wrong

**I cannot find the name.**
Type only the first 4 or 5 letters, for example “Timb”. Then tap **Similar spellings** to see names that are written a little differently. Check that the right country is selected.

**The name has a slash, like “Jigoka/Madungu”.**
That means two places. Search for each name one at a time. Choose the one where the church really meets. If you are not sure, ask your Paul.

**I see the same name in many places.**
Look at the Ward and Sub County in each result. Choose the one that matches the Ward on the form. If there are still two or three, ask your Paul which one is correct.

**I cannot read the handwriting.**
Do not guess. Ask your Paul to write the name clearly.

**I have no internet.**
After you have opened the finder once with internet, the search still works without internet. Only the map needs internet.
